problem_text: In the "opened their ___" example, AI predicted "presents" as most likely (40%) and "clouds" as extremely unlikely (0.000001%). What does this reveal about how training data influences AI's predictions?

solution.option: AI predicts words at random, with no connection to training data.
AI assigns higher probabilities to words that appeared more often in similar contexts within its training data.
AI always chooses the least common word to be creative.
Training data has no impact on which words AI predicts.
